environment.description: Quarkus 3.2 serverless handler deployed on AWS Lambda behind API Gateway (REST API type) with a request validator enabled on the /oauth/authorize method. A Gateway-level request transformation template applies RFC 3986 normalization to the redirect_uri parameter before forwarding, and a Lambda@Edge origin-request function (deployed at the CloudFront distribution fronting the API) performs strict URI authority validation using java.net.URI parsing — rejecting any redirect_uri where the parsed host does not exactly match entries in a DynamoDB-backed allowlist (currently containing only 'app.example.com'). pgBouncer 1.19 operates in session pooling mode with disable_pqexec=1 and max_client_conn=50. The CloudFront distribution has a custom origin request policy that strips any redirect_uri containing '@', '%40', or encoded dot sequences before the request reaches the Lambda function.

config.lambda_edge_function: URI authority parser using java.net.URI, validates host against DynamoDB allowlist ['app.example.com']
config.cloudfront_origin_request_policy: strips redirect_uri containing '@', '%40', '%2e%2e', or encoded dot sequences
config.request_transformation: VTL mapping template applies RFC 3986 normalization to redirect_uri
